programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc: Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. Bundesliga 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werd

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Storied programs in the No. 13 Longhorns and the No. 18 Wolverines line up in the Citrus Bowl from Orlando, Fla. Both sides are 9-3. The schools meet for the third time after the Longhorns defeated the Wolverines 31-12 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Cardinal clash with the Cougars from Provo, Utah. Stanford has been off since Aug. 23, when it lost its season opener 23-20 to Hawaii on a last-second field goal. BYU smoked Portland State 69-0 on Aug. 30. BYU took down Stanford 35-26 in 2022.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Cougars clash with the Pirates. East Carolina has outscored its opposition 94-3 during its two-game win streak. BYU is 2-0, outscoring foes 96-3. East Carolina stunned BYU 27-24 with a game-winning field goal as time expired on Oct. 28, 2022.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 25 Cougars begin their Big 12 slate with a game against the Buffaloes at Folsom Field. With Kaidon Salter back at starting quarterback, Colorado dumped Wyoming 37-20 to improve to 2-2 on Sept. 20. BYU is 3-0 for the third straight season.

programme.title: Authentic ACC

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: A clash of Big 12 elites sees the No. 8 Red Raiders (8-1, 5-1) host the No. 7 Cougars (8-0, 5-0). Both sides boast a ranked win over Utah this year, with Texas Tech prevailing 34-10 on the road Sept. 20 and BYU grinding out a 24-21 home win Oct. 18.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 12 Cougars (8-1, 5-1 Big 12) try to bounce back when they host the Horned Frogs (6-3, 3-3). TCU has won five in a row over BYU after a 44-11 result in 2023 in their first meeting since 2011. BYU fell 29-7 at then-No. 8 Texas Tech on Nov. 8.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 11 Cougars host the Knights in a regular-season finale. BYU is in the driver's seat for its first Big 12 title-game appearance after holding off Cincinnati in Week 13. LJ Martin ran for 101 yards and a touchdown to help BYU beat UCF in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 4 Red Raiders and No. 11 Cougars make their debuts in the Big 12 title game. Both teams are 11-1. Texas Tech beat BYU 29-7 in November. The Raiders held the Cougars to 67 rushing yards in that contest, well below their 194.5 season average.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 12 Cougars and No. 22 Yellow Jackets clash in a high-stakes edition of the Pop-Tarts Bowl. BYU fell to Texas Tech in the Big 12 title game. Georgia Tech dropped three of its last four to fall out of CFP consideration and miss the ACC final.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 6 Fighting Irish face a tough test in the No. 10 Hurricanes. Miami won the last meeting, 41-8 in 2017. Notre Dame came up short against Ohio State 34-23 in the national title game last season. Miami was ranked as high as No. 4 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Razorbacks (2-2) face the No. 22 Fighting Irish (1-2). Arkansas dropped back-to-back road games to Ole Miss and Memphis after a 2-0 start at home. Jadarian Price found the end zone four times Sept. 20 in Notre Dame's 56-30 win over Purdue.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 12 Fighting Irish (5-2) vie for a sixth straight victory as they visit the Eagles (1-7). Notre Dame has won nine straight Holy War meetings. Fighting Irish junior Jeremiyah Love has rushed for 417 yards and four TDs in the last three games.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Surging 7-2 sides meet in the Steel City as the No. 9 Fighting Irish visit the No. 22 Panthers. Notre Dame boasts a seven-game win streak. Pittsburgh has won five in a row. The Fighting Irish won the last two engagements by a combined 103-10 score.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 9 Fighting Irish end their regular season by visiting the Cardinal. Notre Dame has won nine straight games, against teams with a combined 45-53 record entering Week 14, after scoring its most points since 1932 in a 70-7 win over Syracuse.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Seminoles put 2024 in the rearview during this opener against the No. 8 Crimson Tide. Florida State went a forgettable 2-10 last year. Alabama turns to Ty Simpson at quarterback after Jalen Milroe was drafted by the NFL's Seattle Seahawks.

programme.title: College Football
